terms.gloss: a sea-robber, a corsair, a pirate
evidence: Cic. Off. 3.107: nam pīrāta nōn est ex perduellium numerō dēfīnītus, sed commūnis hostis omnium (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: nam pīrāta nōn est ex perduellium numerō dēfīnītus, sed commūnis hostis omnium
phrases.english: for a pirate is not counted among lawful enemies, but is the common enemy of all
